precondition: Verified independent raw video, reliable event-video time/camera mapping and applicable terms; all Task7-A stop conditions resolved

future_preregistered_rule.severity_field: Existing sealed event minimum TTC; do not replace with onset TTC or re-extract full trajectories
future_preregistered_rule.ordering: Within each window order by event minimum TTC ascending then SHA256(window|sealed_event_id|20261030)
future_preregistered_rule.middle: 4 contiguous central order statistics, excluding already selected events
future_preregistered_rule.representative: First 4 remaining by SHA256 order, record unavailable contextual strata rather than invent cases
future_preregistered_rule.contextual_coverage: Before selection freeze, record stable-leader/observed-transition/incomplete-or-quality-flag support in each severity layer; any deterministic quota refinement requires a versioned pre-video plan, never post-view replacement
future_preregistered_rule.controls: Same window, lane/independent30s block/speed layer where available; at most one appearance of each follower trajectory; no inference from repeated Task6 control rows
future_preregistered_rule.blind_order: Domain-separated SHA256(Review|window|case_key|20261030) order after fixed list; secret event/control mapping only locally

future_media_context: Onset +/-5s where supported, actual available context recorded
not_created_reason: No prerequisite has been established; no samples selected or review performed.
